rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a dignified, serious person, manner, or occasion.

example.english: They looked stately at the principal’s retirement ceremony.
example.traditional: 佢今日着得好莊重，出席校長嘅退休典禮。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek6 dak1 hou2 zong1 zung6 ceot1 zik6 haau6 zoeng2 ge3 teoi3 jau1 din2 lai5

rows.note: Use this for something grand, impressive, or imposing, especially a building, place, or person.

example.english: This building looks really stately, with its floor-to-ceiling windows and high ceilings.
example.traditional: 呢座大樓有落地玻璃同高樓底，真係好有氣派。
example.jyutping: ne1 zo6 daai6 lau4 jau5 lok6 dei6 bo1 lei4 tung4 gou1 lau4 dai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 hei3 paai3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on slow, unhurried movement or manner rather than grandeur.

example.english: They walked into the meeting room in a stately, unhurried manner, not looking rushed at all.
example.traditional: 佢慢條斯理咁行入會議室，完全唔似趕時間。
example.jyutping: keoi5 maan6 tiu4 si1 lei5 gam3 haang4 jap6 wui6 ji5 sat1 jyun4 cyun4 m4 ci5 gon2 si4 gaan1
